title: Inteqaam
desc: After his sister Chhaya is raped and justice denied, Birju loses his parents to grief. Fueled by rage, he seeks revenge by kidnapping Dinanath's sister.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Kismat Konnection
desc: Raj, a struggling architect, and Priya, a disillusioned activist, cross paths. Destiny connects them in surprising ways, leading to love, hope, and a chance at new beginnings.

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Agent Vinod
desc: Agent Vinod uncovers a chilling truth: his colleague's death was orchestrated by a powerful business elite. As tensions rise, he must navigate danger to seek justice and uncover the conspiracy.

title: Crook
desc: Jai, a small-time crook equipped with a new identity, is sent to Australia by his uncle. However, there he gets embroiled in the ongoing racial conflict while also trying to pursue his love interest.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Hatya
desc: Sagar brings home a boy and treats him like his younger brother only to find out that the police suspect Sagar as the killer of the boy's mother.

title: Toofan
desc: Balbir Singh stands up against a tyrannical chief minister, fighting for the oppressed citizens who suffer under a regime that uses the king's name to justify its cruelty.

title: God Tussi Great Ho
desc: Arun blames God for his troubles, but when God appears and grants him divine powers, Arun tries to make the world better by fulfilling everyone's wishes.

title: Loafer
desc: Ravi, an unemployed man, is framed for a gangster's murder. With no support from his family, he must fight alone to prove his innocence.

title: Vicky Donor
desc: Vicky, a young man, becomes a sperm donor at Dr. Baldev's fertility clinic, leading to humorous and heartwarming events as he navigates unexpected responsibilities.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Ground Zero
desc: BSF officer Dubey leads a two-year probe into the 2001 Parliament attack, uncovering Ghazi Baba as the mastermind and triggering India's biggest anti-terror operation.

title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain
desc: Ganga, a kind-hearted villager raised by foster parents, returns to his biological family in the city but struggles to adjust to modern life and its contrasting values.
